title: Source-first IA status focus
summary: This iteration adds a reader-facing source status focus section between the source dashboard and the full source graph. It groups blocked, skipped or unconfigured, updated-not-selected, no-recent-update, and parsed-not-candidate source states so important source health signals remain visible before the reader reaches the full fixed-order source map.

lessons.lesson: A complete source graph can still hide actionable source states if the reader must scan every group manually.
lessons.evidence: The new focus section places need-action, updated-not-selected, no-recent-update, and parsed-not-candidate groups before the full graph while preserving fixed ordering inside each group.
lessons.recommended_action: Use the focus section as the default place for future source-health summaries instead of adding more hero cards.

lessons.lesson: Zero-count source states should be explicit when they are part of the operating contract.
lessons.evidence: The focus section renders zero-count groups such as no-recent-update even when no rows currently match, making absence auditable instead of implicit.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep zero-state rows in future source-status UI so readers can distinguish healthy absence from missing instrumentation.

followups.action: Evaluate whether the full source graph should gain a lightweight collapsible status index once more logical source rows are added to the public contract.
